zh-CN.immediate_message: 如果危险正在发生，请立即拨打 120 急救或 110 报警，并让可信任的人来到你身边。
zh-CN.support_message: 全国统一心理援助热线 12356 可提供心理支持；它不能替代正在发生危险时的急救或报警。

actions.label: 拨打 12356 心理援助热线

en-US.immediate_message: If danger is immediate, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department, and ask a trusted person to stay with you.
en-US.support_message: Call or text 988, or use 988 Lifeline chat, for crisis support in the United States.

en-GB.immediate_message: If life is in danger, call 999 for an ambulance or go straight to A&E, and ask someone to stay with you.
en-GB.support_message: Call NHS 111 for urgent help or Samaritans on 116 123 for support.
